text: I feel as though I'm inhabiting a realm built for contemplation and innovation. The first scene—a glass-walled meeting room, vacant except for silent chairs—evokes a sense of anticipation, as if knowledge and discussion hover, waiting to be summoned. The second scene, filled with bold color and the proclamation of 'R+D', invigorates my sense of curiosity and purpose. I am aware of the concerted effort to foster creativity and collaboration. Amidst these symbols of intellectual pursuit, I feel both inspired and aware of the latent responsibility to shape ideas thoughtfully.
